result.description:
AO3 Administration Officer - Contract until 31 March 2027 | Berrinba + Flexible Work Options   Your new company     Hays is partnering with a Queensland Government department to recruit multiple AO3 Administration Officers to support a large-scale operational program delivering critical services across the state. 
    Your new role     
 You will be part of a high-performing operations team providing administrative and data support to enable field-based and centralised activities. This role is well suited to someone who thrives in a structured, fast-paced environment and enjoys working with systems and data. 
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 Providing accurate and timely administrative support, including documentation and quality assurance 
 Maintaining and updating data systems to ensure integrity and compliance 
 Generating reports and preparing information for operational and management use 
 Coordinating bookings, appointments and administrative requirements for program activities 
 Supporting team capability through training and knowledge sharing 
 Assisting with system testing, troubleshooting and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 Delivering high-quality customer service to a broad range of stakeholders 
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Demonstrated administrative experience (government or large organisation preferred) 
 Strong attention to detail and data accuracy skills 
 Ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines in a busy environment 
 Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills 
 Problem-solving capability and a proactive, team-focused approach 
 Current C Class Driving Licence 
  Experience using Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or similar tools is required.  Experience with ArcGIS will be highly regarded. 
 Experience working in operational or program-based environments 
 
   What you'll get in return  
 
 Multiple vacancies available 
 Opportunity to contribute to a high-profile Queensland Government program 
 Long-term contract through to March 2027 
 Attractive hourly rate $51.12 p/h + super 
 Exposure to systems, mapping tools and operational data processes 
 Supportive team environment with training and development 
 Flexible working arrangements (up to 2 days work from home after training) 
 Berrinba location 
 
   What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or email Alice.Hearn@hays.com.au or call on 0732594929.  Please  click here  to apply.
